q1_issues.issue: (Member sk_share_1 remaining) predicates the modifier of the group symbol itself — the group-as-object reading the plural rules explicitly warn against — instead of the dedicated "the remaining X" treatment (a portion with SubsetOf plus RestOf) or the distributive rule.

q2_gaps: "remaining X" with no whole stated in the sentence — the RestOf/partitive form requires a definite whole to relate the remainder to, and this isolated sentence supplies none

a bare plural subject in a specific (non-generic) episodic clause — the determiner rule routes a bare plural to the generic kind, which is wrong for a one-off future event, leaving the group-witness route unlicensed
notes: The agentful passive assigns the by-phrase the active-subject role and "hold" leaves the shares unchanged (Theme), both correct; Holder for possession-sense "hold" is borderline, since Holder is specified as possession-only (own/have/lack) and the instruction set's own "the tank holds forty litres" example assigns Agent. The collective noun "management" correctly takes Member with no GroupOf and no distribution rule.
